task.title: Materialize research-worker-gateway with guarded dispatch
task.summary_zh: 實作 research-worker-gateway 的 bounded dispatch gateway，提供 worker capability registry、job dispatch/status/cancel API 與 health surface；只接安全 stub或已批准 adapter，不做 EP5 或 production learning activation。
acceptance: research-worker-gateway exposes capability list dispatch status cancel and health APIs
Dockerfile env storage and compose wiring are added
gateway rejects unapproved production learning or live execution adapters by default
tests cover dispatch idempotency rejection policy status replay and compose config
task.next: Owner finalized approved research-worker-gateway task. Codex review approved the guarded dispatch gateway, persisted rejection/status behavior, Docker/compose wiring, and focused verification; task closed as completed.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：gateway 已提供 health/capabilities/job dispatch/list/read/status/cancel API；安全 stub/handoff/manual dispatch 受 active-job bound 保護；production/paper/canary/live、EP5/production-learning、LEAN/SignalStore/live execution、registry/governance write、unknown worker 與 real backend dispatch 皆預設拒絕並持久化；job/event/output store、status replay、Dockerfile/env/volume/healthcheck/compose smoke wiring 均已驗證。
